design.status: Exploratory design chosen after inconclusive operating-outcome tests, fixed before these fits.
design.question: Do ghost reports from one set of applicants correspond to reports of unavailability from different applicants at the same firm in the same year?
design.source: Original new_merged2.csv only; no new API labels or Loujaina data.
design.separation: Normalize narrative text; assign identical narratives to the same deterministic SHA256 fold across all companies and years. Deduplicate within company, year, narrative and offer status. Exclude empty or very short narratives.
design.primary_target: Held-out no-offer reviews with known_fake OR future_role OR no_hiring_intent. These are automated narrative features, not independently verified employer intent.
design.primary_predictor: Share of original stored ghost flags in the other review fold, using all reported offer outcomes.
design.sample: At least 10 training reviews and at least 5 held-out no-offer reviews in each firm-year. Both fold directions reported.
primary_models: Year effects with training no-offer share, negative-experience share, log review count and mean narrative length controls.
Firm and year effects with the same controls.
design.weights: Held-out no-offer review count; firm-clustered errors; two-sided 95% intervals; Holm correction over four primary fits.
sensitivity: Process-only predictor excluding all four unavailability flags and internal hiring.
Consecutive next-year reports using all prior-year reviews with no temporal overlap.
design.diagnostics: Held-out AUROC, low/high predictor quartile target rates, target and sample counts. Quartiles use predictor only, never target labels.
design.limits: Tests cross-applicant convergence within one review platform and one automated coding system. Does not establish classification precision, vacancy prevalence, employer intent, causal effects, or the Lourie posting interaction.
design.reporting: Report every planned fit. Do not change models, thresholds or fold seed based on outcomes. Retain all earlier results.

checks.ground_truth: Automated narrative features; not verified vacancy status.
checks.analysis_status: Exploratory cross-applicant convergence check; retains previous inconclusive economic tests.

interpretation: Limited cross-company convergence, modest ranking, no clear within-company evidence. Does not establish a powerful or independently validated classifier.

verification.temporal_implementation_correction: Excluded 50 repeated company narratives across years before final temporal fit, to avoid narrative reuse. Same-year fits unchanged.
